notes: Trusted screenshot over raw profile. Warm paper bg #F2EFE6 (raw rgb(242,239,230)) confirmed in both captures; pure white only on small fills (buttons/tiles), so surface=white, bg=paper. fg normalized to near-black #0A0A0A (raw reports white text because the dominant black void panel sets color:#fff for ink-on-dark; on the paper half text is black) — `muted` is the SAME ink as fg, this design has NO grey: secondary copy is differentiated by SERIF family + smaller size, not by colour, so muted is set equal to fg deliberately. Accent #C38133 is the orange disc (raw rgb(195,129,51)); a second blue #3C4CC7 (rgb(60,76,199)) exists in the stylesheet but is off-viewport, kept under roles only. Display size normalized to 5.4rem (raw 86.4px = 5.4rem at 16px root) with leading 0.85 (raw 73.44/86.4≈0.85 — very tight) and tracking ~-0.04em (raw -3.456px on 86.4px). Two-family system: NeueHaasGrotesk (sans, all headline + UI) + RecklessNeue serif (subhead voice only). Radius: 4px on buttons/tiles, 100% on the disc. One soft shadow inferred from the disc casting onto the paper panel across the seam; rest of site is shadowless. MOTION: frame sequence did NOT capture the choreography — all 11 scroll stills are byte-near-identical because the page is scroll-hijacked/smooth-scrolled with a pinned hero; the only visible delta is the disc's 'Menu' label rotating off-frame. Motion grounded in probes (6 IO / 37 targets / threshold 0.25 / rootMargin 200px, 295 rAF/pass, 17 transition rules, 3 minified @keyframes dSRjOm/gzjafi/gneoFG with no semantic clue), not watched frames. Signature is pin-heavy/drift-light: 6 scroll effects, 5 of them pins + 1 rotate (108.2 deg on the disc label). Reduced motion IS respected (11 PRM rules) — rare for an expressive/agency site; recorded as reduced_motion:respected. 14 mousemove listeners are bound but profiler saw 0 cursor-followers / 0 hover effects, so pointer-reactive ambient is wired-but-unconfirmed (excluded from techniques). 0 libraries detected (hand-rolled); smooth-scroll-hijack listed in stack as the inferred engine. Entrance deltas were from==to (1.00->1.00 / 0.00->0.00) so dropped as noise; staggered-entrance kept on the strength of staggeredEntrance:true + 700ms stagger + IO probes.
